optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Search Quality Analyst, Knowledge Search Product

professionalSummary.text: Three years of experience as a Search Quality Analyst on a knowledge search product, consistently measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme and adhering to the team's measurement standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Search quality analyst on a knowledge search product for three years, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard with monthly judgement batches.

experienceHighlights.text: Analyzed query logs weekly to identify failure patterns and produced comprehensive weekly quality reports for the search product manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Analysed the query logs for failure patterns each week and prepared the weekly quality report for the search product manager, with the reports filed in the search quality folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes, documented expected effects, and secured approval or decline decisions from the search product manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with their expected effect on the quality metrics; each was approved or declined by the search product manager, recorded on the proposal.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated judgement batches with six relevance judges, maintaining clear responsibility boundaries and recording batch designs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the judgement batches with the six relevance judges through the batch schedule, recording which batch designs were mine and which followed the standard templates.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each ranking rule proposal, ensuring clear documentation for ranking engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each ranking rule proposal for the ranking engineers.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a work sample comprising a weekly quality report, two ranking rule proposals with decision records, and a judgement batch design, all referenced in the search quality folder.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one weekly quality report, two ranking rule proposals with their decision records and one judgement batch design, with the search quality folder references as a verification trail.
